serverInfo.name: Google-Agents
serverInfo.title: Google Agents
serverInfo.description: Create and delete Gemini Agents with simple primitive tools. GET discovery is exposed through MCP resources; use Google Agent Editor for complex environment and tool lists.

instructions: Use primitive create variants for straightforward Google Agents. Use the optional file-based create only for complete payloads stored in SharePoint or OneDrive. Use Google-AgentEditor to assemble complex source, network, environment-variable, function, and MCP-server lists. The beta Google API documented here has no update endpoint.
